minUnitsFullTime.label: Full time (financial aid)
minUnitsFullTime.quote: Enrollment requirement: full time = 12 units; three-quarter time = 9-11 units; half-time = 6-8 units.

heavyLoadUnits.label: Top of the normal load
heavyLoadUnits.quote: During spring and fall, the normal academic load for undergraduates is 12 to 15 units per semester and 8 units in the summer. For graduates, the normal load during spring and fall is from 9 to 12 units per semester and 7 units during the summer.

maxUnitsWithoutPermission.label: Priority-registration maximum
maxUnitsWithoutPermission.quote: During priority registration, students may register for a maximum of 19 units of enrolled, including 8 units of wait-listed courses.
